deviations.note: exact reproduction; the plan's value went to the engine unchanged
exact: four million steps of a hundredth of a second is forty thousand seconds

read 4.28961e-10 against an expected 4.50090e-10, a ratio of 0.95306 -- inside the one decade the goal set as its target. The agreement confirms the integrator and the estimator and is not evidence about the diffusivity of anything
the same comparison as a bare ratio, so a reader does not have to divide

estimation.note: the weighted least squares the vocabulary declares, run by the backend and citing the contract in its own output. What is compared here is the fit range, which is the part of the estimator a run can fail to honour by stopping early

numbers.name: temperature
numbers.note: the room's, read off a thermometer. In this configuration temperature is constitutive -- a parameter of the noise amplitude with no mechanism that could fail to realise it -- so citing it records why the value was chosen and is not evidence about the model

numbers.name: viscosity
numbers.note: pure water; the entry's validity runs 288 to 298 K and the temperature above is inside it

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the laboratory's tracer, measured by the operator on 2026-09-19. Provenance of D_T and of the sweep's centre, NOT a parameter of abp_free

numbers.name: n_particles
numbers.note: non-interacting walkers, a statistics knob and not a density. A hundred keeps the trajectory inside two gigabytes at the save interval this point needs Unit 1 and not count, changed at revision 4. `count` carries an amount dimension in the registry and `1` does not, so a particle count declared as `count` cannot be multiplied into anything: particles times steps is an amount, and dividing that by a rate gives amount-seconds, which no unit spells. The cost estimates the envelope gate compares against ceilings are exactly that product, so they could not be written at all. This tree already follows the convention -- the interacting active question declares its per-arm particle counts dimensionless for the same reason, and an older goal carried a cube root of a count as `1` noting that the cube root of a count is not a count. Nothing physical changes; a hundred particles is a hundred particles.

numbers.name: translational_diffusivity
numbers.note: held fixed across the whole grid. One significant figure because the worst input carries one

numbers.name: rotational_diffusivity
numbers.note: the sphere's own Stokes-Einstein-Debye value, 3*D_T/d^2. This revision sits ON the realisable centre rather than off it, so every number here describes one physical particle. Unit 1/s and not rad^2/s: the registry gives rad the dimension A, so rad^2/s cannot enter any formula check 17 can evaluate, and a radian is dimensionless

numbers.name: self_propulsion_speed
numbers.note: 2.97 um/s at one significant figure

numbers.name: persistence_time_expected
numbers.note: 1/((d-1)*D_R) is 1/D_R in two dimensions. Consistent with the rotational diffusivity above BY CONSTRUCTION, which revision 2 was not: it carried the sweep top for one and the sweep bottom for the other, and A1 failed check 17 on the mismatch

numbers.name: thermal_crossover_time
numbers.note: tau_1 = D_T/v0^2, the EARLY crossover where the thermal regime gives way to the ballistic one. The three-regime structure is the reason this number exists: the MSD starts at slope 1, not 2

numbers.name: peclet_thermal
numbers.note: the collapse variable v0/sqrt((d-1)*D_R*D_T) at this operating point. 100 gives Lambda = 1e4, where the maximum log-log slope is 1.98 -- the ballistic regime is present and clean. At Pe_thermal of 10 the maximum is 1.79 and at 1 it is 1.12

numbers.name: integration_timestep_planned
numbers.note: a decade below the save interval so a saved frame never falls between steps. Three decades under A1's ceiling, which for this configuration is D_R*dt <= 0.01 and nothing else -- there is no length in the free model for a displacement-per-step bound to compare against

numbers.name: total_simulated_time_planned
numbers.note: four hundred persistence times. NOT A2's floor, which is a hundred: A4 requires a window of at least 3000 s and A2 requires the window to be at most a tenth of the record, so the pair forces at least 30000 s and 400 tau_R is the next round multiple above it. The 400 is a decision and carries no grade; the seconds inherit E4 from the persistence time

numbers.name: save_interval_planned
numbers.note: a decade under A4's ceiling. STORAGE IS WHAT SETS IT, not the physics: at the early crossover tau_1 = D_T/v0^2 it would resolve all three regimes and cost 6.4 GB against a 10 GB ceiling for one run, and this buys the ballistic peak and the whole crossover to diffusion for 0.6 GB. The shortest lag is then ten times tau_1, so the run enters the ballistic regime already risen and does not show it rise -- recorded as a rejection rather than left to be discovered in the output

numbers.name: max_lag_time_planned
numbers.note: at A4's floor, thirty persistence times. Taking more window would push the record longer still through A2's ratio without buying a regime the run does not already cover

numbers.name: fit_lag_range_lower_bound_planned
numbers.note: the window parameter of effective_translational_diffusivity; a value read earlier is D_T under that name (contracts/observables.json)

numbers.name: target_relative_error
numbers.note: ten per cent on the effective diffusivity, well inside the decade the goal asks for

numbers.name: effective_diffusivity_expected
numbers.note: the long-time limit of the closed form, which is what this run is checked AGAINST rather than what it measures. In two dimensions (d-1) is 1

numbers.name: effective_diffusivity_read
numbers.note: read off the run: 4.28961e-10 m^2/s from the weighted slope of the mean squared displacement over 30000 lags. Carried at one figure because the inputs carry one; the full value is in the run's own observables. A comparison term and not a measurement of the world -- this configuration's output is fixed by its inputs

numbers.name: effective_diffusivity_relative_error
numbers.note: 1.43 per cent, from 50 independent blocks of 2 tracers. THE HONEST ONE: the fit's own relative error is 0.0303 per cent, forty-seven times smaller, because a weighted least squares treats correlated lag points as independent observations

numbers.name: effective_diffusivity_ratio_to_expected
numbers.note: 0.95306 from the FULL values -- 4.28961e-10 read against 4.50090e-10 expected. NO FORMULA, deliberately: the two numbers as this card carries them are rounded to one significant figure, so dividing those gives 0.8 and the dimension check would hold the card to that. A ratio of two one-figure numbers still says whether they agree, and it can only say it at the precision the ratio was taken

numbers.name: integration_timestep_actual
numbers.note: what the engine was handed

numbers.name: total_simulated_time_actual
numbers.note: derived from the integer step count, never accumulated

numbers.name: save_interval_actual
numbers.note: what the engine was handed

numbers.name: msd_loglog_slope_max
numbers.note: the largest local slope of log mean squared displacement against log lag, at 3.4 s. Three figures because the criterion is a comparison at the third digit and one figure could not express it

numbers.name: msd_loglog_slope_longest_lag
numbers.note: the same slope at the longest lag in the window, where the plan expects it back at 1

numbers.name: max_single_step_displacement
numbers.note: 5.43e-07 m, against a box of 0.003 m -- a factor of 5523 under. The guard is not met and for this one not met is the good outcome: met would mean the integration broke. The box bounds nothing physical here, so this is a divergence guard and not an image bound

assumptions.statement: The thermal Peclet number is set to 100 at this single operating point, where Lambda = 1e4 and the maximum log-log slope is 1.98. Chosen so the ballistic regime is present rather than marginal: at Pe_thermal of 10 the maximum slope is 1.79 and at 1 it is 1.12.
assumptions.falsifier: a run whose maximum log-log slope falls below 1.9, which would mean this point does not reach the regime it was chosen to reach

assumptions.statement: A thousand non-interacting walkers per point. Nothing physical picks this; it is the statistics knob, and the particles do not interact so it is not a density.
assumptions.falsifier: a statistical error on D_eff that this ensemble cannot reach inside budget

assumptions.statement: A ten per cent statistical error needs of order one hundred independent displacements at the longest fit lag, from the square-root scaling of an ensemble mean; the prefactor for a weighted slope estimator on an active MSD has not been measured.
assumptions.falsifier: a seed-to-seed spread wider than ten per cent at this sample count raises the floor

kb_refs.claim: The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
The laboratory's ambient temperature is 20 degrees Celsius, read off a thermometer by the operator. It is a reading and not a setpoint, and it is the room's rather than the sample's.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second, and it changes by roughly two percent per kelvin in that neighbourhood.
